description: Source code for Zephyr OS's Non-Volatile Storage (NVS) backend, handling loading, saving, and initialization of settings stored in flash memory.

methods.name: settings_nvs_load
methods.description: Loads settings from NVS storage and applies them via handlers.

methods.name: settings_nvs_save
methods.description: Saves or deletes a setting in NVS storage.

methods.name: settings_nvs_backend_init
methods.description: Initializes the NVS backend, mounting flash and setting up the filesystem.

methods.name: settings_backend_init
methods.description: Configures and initializes the default NVS storage and registers source/destination.

methods.name: settings_nvs_storage_get
methods.description: Retrieves the underlying NVS filesystem object.
